text:
maria-l: Hey team — got a surprise bill from TeleCareMD for a telehealth visit on 2026-03-10. Insurance portal shows provider as OUT-OF-NETWORK and they billed me $85. I thought telehealth with that clinic was in-network. Claim ID: CLAIM-7890123. Plan: Redwood Standard PPO. Any tips? Do I file an appeal or ask provider to re-submit? :confused:
jamal: @maria-l ugh sorry to hear. First step: double-check provider directory — sometimes clinics have multiple billing TINs. Can you DM last 4 of your member ID? Also did you get a superbill or itemized bill from TeleCareMD?
maria-l: Member ID ends ...4321. I got an emailed receipt but it's generic — no TIN. Provider site said "TeleCareMD (virtual)" — so confusing.
ben-hr: Hi @maria-l — we can help coordinate with the insurer's claims team. Typical path: 1) ask provider to re-bill using the in-network billing NPI/TIN if it was a coding issue; 2) if provider refuses, file an insurer appeal with "wrong provider network classification" + attach encounter notes. You'll want the itemized bill. 
jamal: Also, here's a short script you can use to ask the provider billing team:

```
Hi — I was seen on 3/10/2026 (CLAIM-7890123). My insurance is Redwood Standard PPO, member ID ****4321.
The claim was paid as out-of-network but this provider is listed as in-network for telehealth. Please confirm the billing NPI/TIN used and re-submit to the insurer under the correct network status.
Thanks, Maria
```

insuresvc-bot: Provider lookup: https://insurer.example.com/provider-search?name=TeleCareMD — shows multiple entries, one in-network for telehealth (NPI 1234567890). 
maria-l: Thanks — I called billing and they said they used a different billing entity. They said they'd resubmit but asked if I should still file an appeal with the insurer now.
ben-hr: If provider will promptly re-submit, wait 2 weeks; if no movement, file an appeal referencing CLAIM-7890123 and attach the email from provider promising re-bill. We can redact any PHI and send from benefits@redwood.com if you want.
jamal: If you want us to escalate, reply here with "OK to share" and we'll open a ticket with the insurer and include the claim + member info. :+1:
maria-l: OK to share. Appreciate it — attaching screenshot in DM.
people-ops: Noted, @maria-l. We'll reach out to insurer's claims team and keep you posted. :v:
maria-l: Thanks everyone, feeling better already.
